feynrl_repo.title: FeynRL: RL post-training library (local clone)
feynrl_repo.sha_source: .git/refs/heads/main (read from disk by discover_repo.py; no git invocation)
feynrl_repo.note: Line anchors refer to the local clone at the sha above. discover_repo.py records a sha256 per module in discovered.json so anchors can be re-verified after a pull.

feynrl_arch_doc.title: FeynRL Architecture Overview
feynrl_arch_doc.note: Prose description of Ray orchestration, DeepSpeed training, vLLM rollout, the three weight-sync methods and the sync/overlap scheduling modes. Anchors are ARCHITECTURE.md:L<n>.

feynrl_paper.title: FeynRL (arXiv 2605.12380)
feynrl_paper.note: Cited only; not read for this thread. No anchors point into it.

feynrl_readme_grpo.title: algs/GRPO/README.md: GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization)
feynrl_readme_grpo.note: Contains the clipped-loss formula, the 'training batches are not group-structured' note, and the decoupled-loss (overlap mode) derivation shared by GRPO/PPO/CISPO.

feynrl_readme_cispo.title: algs/CISPO/README.md: CISPO (Clipped Importance Sampling Policy Optimization)
feynrl_readme_cispo.note: Contrasts the stop-gradient clipped-ratio weighting with PPO/GRPO min-clip.

feynrl_readme_rl.title: algs/RL/README.md: RL Common (common.py)
feynrl_readme_rl.note: Shared forward passes, proximal snapshot, KL estimator, numerical safeguards, global token normalization.

feynrl_example_gsm8k.title: examples/llm/rl/gsm8k/qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct/train_sync.yaml (and train_async.yaml)
feynrl_example_gsm8k.note: The one recipe traced in this thread. train_async.yaml differs from train_sync.yaml only in experiment_id/checkpoint_dir, weight_sync_method (nccl) and overlap.enabled (True).

feynrl_unit_tests.title: FeynRL unit and integration tests
feynrl_unit_tests.note: Used for status 'tested'. Anchors are unit_tests/<path>:L<range>.
